evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Inspired by the human cognitive process of "backtracking" to specific acoustic cues during complex listening tasks, DeALR establishes a dynamic interaction between learnable thought tokens and acoustic segments.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Comprehensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that DeALR consistently outperforms prior test-time optimization approaches, delivering substantial improvements in both confidence calibration and reasoning accuracy.
